title: Uniform indices for semi-log-canonical log Calabi–Yau pairs
main_claim: For d>=4 and finite Phi in [0,1]∩Q there is a(d,Phi) such that for every connected projective slc log CY pair (X,B) of dimension d with coefficients in Phi, a(K_X+B) is Cartier and linearly trivial (independent of number of components). Proof: normal index (UPI) -> edge residue ratios on conductor graph -> closed walks give B-birational self-maps of minimal klt strata -> uniform character exponent (Thm characters) via product cover + bounded rank of the top-form Hodge structure T(U) (Thm rank, proved via a Hodge-norm gap lemma, a diagonal Seshadri estimate, and a fibration/calibration counting argument).

issues.description: Birkar 2023 Cor. 1.4 (effective birationality / volume lower bound on klt CY varieties) is applied to the pushforward Ā, which is big and integral but not shown to be nef. As far as I recall, the cited result is stated for nef and big Weil divisors.
issues.evidence: The text says 'Its hypotheses are exactly that X̄ is projective klt, K≡0, and Ā is big and integral'. Easy fix: run an Ā-MMP on (X̄, εĀ). This keeps K≡0 klt, Ā stays an integral Weil divisor and becomes nef (and semiample) on the resulting model, and vol(Ā) is unchanged. So the bound vol ≥ M^{-n} still holds.

issues.location: sections/rank.tex Thm rank + sections/characters.tex Lemma char:hodge-bound (via UPI Lemma 5.2)
issues.description: Theorem rank, combined with UPI Lemma 5.2 (lower-dimensional rational images of irreducible CY/HK factors are rationally connected), implies a uniform bound on dim T(U) in each dimension. This would give bounded b2 for projective hyperkähler manifolds of each dimension, and bounded b3/h^{2,1} for strict Calabi–Yau threefolds; both are well-known open problems. I found no failing step in this paper's own arguments, so this is not a located gap. But the full weight of these consequences rests on the companion inputs UPI Lemmas 6.2–6.4 (generic chains, tracking, small Iitaka-fibre volumes) and Prop. 4.1, which I did not re-audit here.
issues.evidence: For an HK with ρ=1, T(U)⊂H^{2k} contains the harmonic part generated by σ^k in Sym^k T(H^2), which has dimension ≥ b2−1. For a very general CY3, T=H^3, of rank 2h^{2,1}+2. With ρ=1, the proof of Thm rank reduces to: large r ⇒ small normalized Seshadri constant (diagonal lemma) ⇒ low-order covering family (UPI inputs) ⇒ nontrivial contraction, which is impossible.

coverage: Read in full: introduction, preliminaries, hodge.tex, diagonal.tex, rank.tex, rank-calibration.tex, rank-count.tex. Read the boundary-free factor lemma and the end of the main theorem proof in characters.tex and residues.tex. Checked step by step: Hodge-gap lemma (variation formula, deficit bounds, (1-p)^2<=d0, |A-B|^2<=N_n e, |B|^2>=|γ|^2-2e, harmonic/exact orthogonality, δ_n). Diagonal lemma (layer count vs Q_m, parameter margins, lct/colength exclusion and independence of products, adjoint ample-model base-locus removal, self-pairing of v, Dv=-t[F]H1^n, ∫vD^n=-t^n l, exceptional-norm R^{-n/2} via fibre integration and H1^n∧ω^n<=R^{-n}ω^{2n}, final bound on r). Rank theorem (low-order lemma including the trivial-normal-bundle jet count, comparison x^*L ⪯ y^*N', attainment via terminal domination plus κ=0 on members, MMP with no divisorial steps, F_0 contraction via length bound, verticality via bigness of D−δA/3, maximality, vertical jet rank, jet-determinant + base-wedge + Campana–Păun slope bound, Frobenius-power GMS section count h0<=u(μ+b)^b/b!, final contradiction). Characters: integral isometry of T(U), Kronecker, totient. Descent: constancy of edge ratios, spanning-tree rescaling, S2/Cartier, field descent. Not re-audited: companion inputs UPI (Thm 1.1/1.2, Lemmas 5.2, 6.2–6.4, Prop 4.1/4.5), LA Thm 11.1, LOGI product cover; residue comparison lemmas res:within/res:across only skimmed.
sibling_notes: The board already had an entry for this exact dir (an earlier rank171 run, also no_gap_found). My independent re-audit agrees with it and I overwrote the entry with my own summary. Family-034 companions UPI and LA were audited by siblings as no_gap_found but conditional on further companions. The rank theorem here effectively claims bounded b2 for hyperkähler manifolds and bounded h^{2,1} for strict CY3s, so any gap in UPI Lemmas 6.2–6.4 (tracking / small Iitaka-fibre volume) would propagate here. Whoever audits UPI should give those lemmas priority.
